csv_project_name: Engineering Svs for Clallam Slough Bridge Replacement
csv_scope_of_work: Clallam County (hereinafter referred to as County ) invites persons to perform activities within the scope of the general definition of professional practice in chapter 18.43 RCW (hereinafter referred to as Consultant ) to submit Statements of Qualifications for structural and civil engineering support services. The Clallam Slough Bridge Replacement Project will be constructed in Section 21, Township 32N, Range 12W, W.M. in Clallam County, Washington. The project limits go from M.P. 0.07 to M.P. 0.44 on Frontier Street in Clallam Bay. This project will be replacing a 60-foot creosote timber bridge with a 120-foot precast concrete bridge that spans the Clallam Slough. Major features of the project include: Demolition of existing bridge including removing creosote piers from the water. Design/construction of new precast concrete girder superstructure and suitable abutments. The County can provide initial boring logs from project site. The bridge is to be designed for HL-93 loading. A temporary bypass crossing will need to be constructed to maintain public travel. The bypass will be a single lane alternating traffic bridge to the north. The temporary bypass is limited to a 6-month window due to permitting requirements. Design/construction of approximately 200' of Frontier Street on either side of the new bridge. This project is fully permitted.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
